slides.texte_overlay:
Why some guys get noticed
the moment they walk in
They walk in relaxed. Slow pace, head up, a small smile. They don't rush or look around nervously, and it reads as quiet confidence.
They greet people warmly. A real hello to the host, the friends, the people they don't know yet. Warmth is noticed before anything else.
They're well groomed. Fresh haircut, clean clothes, a light scent. Not flashy, just someone who clearly takes care of himself.
They bring energy to the group. A funny story, a good question, real laughter. People are drawn to whoever makes the room feel lighter.
They always have something interesting to say. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it gives me stories people remember.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It gives me stories people remember.

slides.texte_overlay: They're kind to everyone, not just the people they want to impress. How you treat the waiter says more than any compliment.
They respect boundaries. A friendly hello, and if someone isn't interested, they smile and move on. That's what leaves a good impression.
